title: Shader Gallery Material Research Source Catalog
purpose: Discovery and provenance ledger; not an import manifest or a production-readiness claim.

evidenceGrades.E2: direct primary source retrieved at listed locator on observedAt
evidenceGrades.E3: named prior research summary awaiting direct re-check
evidenceGrades.E5: excluded or non-permissive without further authorization

usePolicy: Floating branch URLs are discovery only. A trial must record an immutable commit SHA and downloaded artifact SHA-256 before reuse.
A source may be studied without being copied. Copying/adapting needs the source's license disposition, attribution requirement, and an independently executed compile or behavior check.
No external source establishes physical calibration, mobile performance, or production readiness for Shader Gallery.

sources.title: Khronos glTF Sample Assets — IridescenceAbalone
sources.license: CC-BY-4.0; attribution to Abby Crawford (2015) and Eric Chadwick (2023) per asset README
verifiedFacts: photogrammetry abalone asset
uses KHR_materials_iridescence
R/G pack iridescence intensity/thickness; ORM is separately packed
partial metalness is an acknowledged artistic approximation
permittedStudyUse: attributed asset loading after binary hash
sources.nextGate: G1 pins downloaded GLB SHA-256 and records all asset-derived observations in MVT-ABALONE-001.

sources.title: Khronos KHR_materials_iridescence specification
sources.license: Khronos specification; implementation code is not imported by this catalog
verifiedFacts: factor multiplies iridescence texture red channel
thickness uses texture green channel between nm minimum/maximum
BRDF implementation can vary with resource constraints
notTransferred: claim that a fullscreen proxy is glTF-conformant
sources.nextGate: Compare loaded asset JSON/maps with the pinned specification revision; record deviations rather than silently normalizing them.

sources.title: three.js MeshPhysicalMaterial
verifiedFacts: iridescence, anisotropy, transmission and dispersion are supported material features
iridescence/thickness maps are non-colour data
advanced effects add per-pixel cost and environment lighting materially affects evaluation
legacy iridescenceThicknessRange is deprecated in favor of minimum/maximum properties
sources.nextGate: Lock an npm version and lockfile in an isolated directory; do not depend on the observed development-branch SHA.

sources.title: Soap Bubble Iridescence Simulator
verifiedFacts: public repository describes a WebGL thin-film-interference bubble simulation
repository topics include spectral rendering and thin films
permittedStudyUse: inspect and potentially adapt a small, attributed two-interface/Fresnel mechanism after file-level review
sources.nextGate: Pin the exact adapted source file hash, compile in the declared WebGL environment, and test phase-consistent oscillation against the RGB proxy control.

sources.title: OpenPBR-viewer
verifiedFacts: repository describes itself as an OpenPBR WebGL pathtracer example
the previously cited portsmouth URL redirects to jamportz; this catalog preserves the new canonical locator
permittedStudyUse: comparison vocabulary and independent reference-renderer investigation
sources.nextGate: Compile and inspect only the modules relevant to a named comparison question before any code reuse.

sources.title: Khronos Anisotropy Barn Lamp sample asset
proposedUse: directional reflection/map-channel study for Silver Specular and Labradorite
limits: not evidence that metal anisotropy equals labradorite internal plate behaviour
sources.nextGate: Locate, pin, license-check, and inspect texture semantics before promotion beyond candidate.

sources.title: Khronos DispersionTest sample asset
limits: not evidence for Opal Fire or Labradorite internal colour structures
sources.nextGate: Pin asset and compare against an isolated reference lane.

sources.title: THREE-CustomShaderMaterial
verifiedFacts: project describes itself as extending Three.js standard materials with custom shaders
proposedUse: only if the isolated Three.js lane needs a PBR extension point that native material controls cannot express
limits: adds a dependency surface; no adoption decision has been made
sources.nextGate: Demonstrate an unmet native MeshPhysicalMaterial requirement and pin a version.

sources.title: pmndrs/drei
verifiedFacts: repository provides helpers for react-three-fiber
limits: Shader Gallery does not currently use React Three Fiber; this is not a reason to migrate
sources.nextGate: A measured presentation requirement must justify an R3F decision first.

sources.title: pmndrs/react-postprocessing
sources.license: MIT; underlying postprocessing dependency license must be recorded at adoption
verifiedFacts: repository describes postprocessing for react-three-fiber
proposedUse: future Bloom/Flare Burst experiments after a separate R3F decision
limits: no present R3F lane; no HDR/bloom performance conclusion
sources.nextGate: Treat as deferred until the presentation architecture changes by evidence.

sources.title: Material Maker
verifiedFacts: procedural-texture authoring and 3D-painting tool based on Godot
proposedUse: offline procedural-map authoring and comparison baselines
limits: not a runtime dependency and not evidence of browser compatibility
sources.nextGate: Document graph/version/export settings and resulting map hashes if used.

sources.title: Ashima webgl-noise
verifiedFacts: procedural noise routines compatible with WebGL
proposedUse: small, attributed organic/geological field building blocks
limits: noise is a structural primitive, not material optics or art direction
sources.nextGate: Copy only a named routine after its exact file/version is pinned and compile-tested.

sources.title: glitch-core kaleidoscope shader collection
sources.locator: TO_VERIFY — prior research named this source but did not preserve a durable repository locator
limits: not eligible for import until repository identity, license, and specific module are independently recovered
sources.nextGate: Recover primary URL and license; otherwise replace with original implementation.

sources.title: sparkles optical shader collection
sources.locator: TO_VERIFY — prior research described thin-film, diffraction, sparkle, anisotropy, dispersion and GLSL/WGSL modules without preserving a canonical locator
limits: short visible history and no independent compile/performance review; not an approved dependency
sources.nextGate: Recover canonical repository, license, revision and one module-level test before evaluation.

sources.title: LYGIA shader library
sources.license: Prior research recorded dual Prosperity/Patron licensing; re-check current terms before any commercial use.
limits: public availability is not sufficient reuse permission
sources.nextGate: Do not import under this project until terms are explicitly approved.

sources.title: General Shadertoy discovery pool
limits: individual shaders require their own license review; common CC BY-NC-SA defaults are not a commercial-reuse path
sources.nextGate: Treat as visual study only unless the individual work has a compatible explicit license and attribution path.
